title: Notes on building better AI tutors.
meta:
What research says, what companies are building, and what is still unsolved.
A public working map — not a finished theory.
intro: For now, this is deliberately narrow: one unfinished note on the relationship layer, and one deep investigation into diagnosis. The tutor should not only react to mistakes. It should learn how to investigate them.
footer: The tutor should change its methods until the student can think without it.
